## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the use case? <!-- e.g. "As a team
lead I can't ..." -->

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Does this fit the project's direction?

Next Lane is guided by [`docs/VISION.md`](../../docs/VISION.md) and
[`docs/ROADMAP.md`](../../docs/ROADMAP.md). If your idea relates to something
already on the roadmap, please link it. Bonus points if it leans on one of the
four structural advantages (free & unlimited · your data/your compute · open &
extensible · AI-native).

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or examples that help illustrate the request.
